nom: TOSOWOONG Arbutin 7% + Tranexamic Acid 4% Cream for Dark Spots

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one alternating the cream with retinol and one in her 40s, report the cream absorbs quickly and leaves skin plump and hydrated rather than dry.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, including one who calls herself 'super sensitive' and a post-menopausal reviewer with dry, increasingly sensitive skin, but one reviewer says the packaging itself warns against use on sensitive skin despite marketing claiming it suits all skin types, and she never got to use it.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who names her skin as mature, 52 and post-menopausal, reports a gradual, non-irritating improvement in tone rather than a harsh or fast-acting effect.
segments.oily: One reviewer's husband with oily skin had no irritation and saw his dark spots lightening after two weeks of use, alongside the reviewer's own sensitive skin doing equally well.

concerns.spots: This is the effect most reviewers report and rate on: gradual fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, sunspots or post-acne marks over two weeks to several months of consistent use, often faster with even, careful application. Several reviewers dissent, reporting no change at all after weeks of daily use, and one says the cream made an existing dark area darker instead of lighter.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers credit the cream, which they describe as containing anti-aging ingredients, with tighter-looking skin and smoother lines and wrinkles over a few weeks; one older reviewer with minimal wrinkles reports her skin looking plumper and more hydrated after a single use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report the cream absorbs well and leaves skin soft and hydrated rather than dry, though one critical reviewer says it dried out her skin while her dark spots and breakouts got worse.
concerns.blemishes: Reports diverge: one reviewer says the cream broke her out badly with tiny rashes while doing nothing for her mother's skin either way, while others, including one managing hormonal acne, report their breakouts and related dark marks improving.

aspects.libelle: Tube often feels underfilled or full of air
Can leave a sticky or flaky residue if not fully worked in
Visible results generally take weeks to months of consistent use
A little goes a long way, tube lasts a while
Uneven application can cause patchy lightening

extraits.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, increasingly sensitive skin, I’m very careful with brightening products. Many of them can be too aggressive, especially when they include ingredients like arbutin or tranexamic acid. I’m always looking for formulas that improve overall tone gradually without causing dryness or irritation. This cream fits that role very well. This is not a harsh brightening treatment, and that’s actually one of its strengths. Instead of pushing too hard, it works more as a steady maintenance product that helps improve overall skin tone over time. That’s exactly what I prefer at this stage. The texture is also very well done. It’s lightweight but still feels hydrating enough to function as a cream. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any heaviness on the skin. There’s no stickiness, no greasiness, and no pilling, even when layered over serums or under sunscreen. What I notice most is how this helps my skin look more even and smooth over time. This isn’t an overnight product, and I don’t expect dramatic results from something like this. Instead, it’s more about gradual improvement in tone and overall skin quality, which is often more realistic and sustainable. This also works very well for daytime use, especially if you live in warm weather or humidity.
